title: Let us see what this machine can run
lead: We check your GPU, driver, runtime, ComfyUI nodes and model weights, list anything missing, and install what you tick in one go. Based on the result we also suggest which steps should run locally and which should use an API.
scanNote: Read-only. Nothing is changed. Takes about 10 seconds.

sys.name: System and hardware
sys.hint: Decides which models can run locally
sys.check: GPU and VRAM, driver, memory, disk space

rt.name: Runtime
rt.hint: Python, PyTorch, FFmpeg and other basics
rt.check: Python, the CUDA build of PyTorch, FFmpeg, Git

comfy.name: ComfyUI and nodes
comfy.hint: Runs local image, video and upscaling
comfy.check: ComfyUI version and custom nodes for H3, upscaling, ControlNet

w.name: Model weights
w.check: Weights for video, image, upscaling, voice and local LLM

svc.name: Network and services
svc.hint: Download speed, local LLM server, API keys
svc.check: Access to model hubs, local LLM server, saved API keys

found.torch_not_cuda: Installed, but not the CUDA {{cuda}} build

error.not_detected: Installed, but a fresh check still can't find it (a package that won't import, say); see the log
error.torch_unsupported: No matching build for this machine's PyTorch {{version}} yet; skip it for now
error.no_wheel: No prebuilt package fits this machine, and building it failed
error.dependency_failed: {{item}}, which it needs, did not install
error.interrupted: The install was interrupted; retry it
error.manifest_todo: How to install this is not settled yet ({{field}})
error.step_failed: The {{step}} step failed (exit code {{exit}}); see the log
error.not_installable: This item has no install steps
error.dest_not_empty: The target folder already has other files: {{path}}
error.sha256_mismatch: {{file}} failed its checksum and was deleted; retry it
error.no_package: No {{manager}} package is set for this item
error.snapshot_not_running: ComfyUI isn't running, so no snapshot could be taken and nothing was changed. Open ComfyUI and retry.
error.snapshot_no_manager: This ComfyUI has no ComfyUI-Manager 4 enabled (install it and start ComfyUI with --enable-manager), so no snapshot could be taken and nothing was changed
error.snapshot_forbidden: ComfyUI-Manager's security level doesn't allow this (set it to normal or lower).
error.snapshot_restart: ComfyUI-Manager was just installed. Restart ComfyUI and retry.
error.snapshot_failed: The snapshot failed, so ComfyUI was left as it was.

confirmReason.comfy_change: {{item}} changes your ComfyUI (a snapshot is taken first)

touchesComfyTitle: Not ticked by default. Before installing you approve the list of changes, and a ComfyUI-Manager snapshot is taken first

confirm.title: Confirm before installing
confirm.lead: These need your OK before anything starts. Cancel installs nothing.
confirm.snapshotNote: A ComfyUI-Manager snapshot is taken first. If something breaks, roll back with one click under “Your ComfyUI” below.

comfy.title: Your ComfyUI
comfy.hint: Identified read-only. The studio uses it with its own Python, and asks before changing it
comfy.noManager: Not installed: no snapshots (it is installed first when an install changes ComfyUI)
comfy.truncated: Too many model files: only some are listed.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.hint: Saved by ComfyUI-Manager: the versions of ComfyUI, every node pack and pip package at the time
snapshots.empty: No snapshots yet. One is taken automatically before an install changes ComfyUI.
snapshots.restored: Rollback scheduled: restart ComfyUI to apply
snapshots.restoreLabel: Roll back to the snapshot of {{time}}
snapshots.confirmTitle: Roll back to the snapshot of {{time}}?
snapshots.confirmBody: ComfyUI-Manager restores ComfyUI, its node packs and pip packages to that state the next time ComfyUI starts. The studio does not restart your ComfyUI: restart it yourself afterwards.
snapshots.restartToast: Rollback scheduled: restart ComfyUI to apply

snapshotError.not_running: ComfyUI is not running: open it and try again
snapshotError.forbidden: ComfyUI-Manager's security level does not allow this (set it to normal or lower)
snapshotError.restart: ComfyUI-Manager was just installed: restart ComfyUI and try again
snapshotError.failed: ComfyUI-Manager could not do it: see its log

dirHint: Model weights go here. Leave plenty of space.

hint.auto: Tests speed first and uses the fastest. A failed file is retried from another source.
hint.official: Downloads straight from GitHub, Hugging Face and PyPI.
hint.cn: Uses mirrors in China for Python packages and model weights. Good for slow connections.

installNote: Large files resume if interrupted. Close the app halfway and it picks up next time. Everything installed is recorded so it can be removed cleanly.

estimate.size: About {{size}} (download speed not measured yet, so no time estimate)
estimate.speedNote: Estimated from this machine's measured download speed, {{speed}}

skip: Skip for now and open the studio

log.title: Install log
log.skip_dep: Skipped {{item}}: {{dep}}, which it needs, is not installed
log.snapshot_failed: Couldn't take a ComfyUI snapshot; items that change ComfyUI are skipped this time

done.title: Ready
done.lineFailedRequired: Installed {{done}} items, failed {{failed}}, including a required one. Retry it; if it still fails, switch the steps that need it to an API in Models & fallback.
done.enter: New series: set the output format
done.toModels: Add API keys in Models & fallback
done.later: You can scan again and install more under Environment in the left nav.

local_video.name: Balanced: drafts and reruns local, final take via API
local_video.why: 32 GB of VRAM runs MiniMax H3 locally for video drafts, and image, upscaling, voice and LLM can all run locally too. Only the take you approve goes through an API, which keeps cost low without hurting the final cut.

no_cuda.name: Balanced (video via API)
no_cuda.why: Apple silicon cannot run CUDA video models like MiniMax H3, so video, keyframes and upscaling use APIs. The LLM and voice can run locally to save some money.
